evidence.note: Hand reaches the closed entry-area closet door handle.
Closet door is visibly open, exposing hanging clothes and shoes.
Hand is on the closet door handle as the door closes.
Closet door is fully closed.
Hand grasps the microwave handle while the door is closed.
Microwave door is opening outward.
Hand pushes the open microwave door toward the appliance.
Microwave door is fully closed.
Hand grasps the closed oven handle.
Oven door is lowered open and the illuminated interior is visible.
Oven door is partway through closing.
Hand finishes closing the oven door.
Hand approaches the closed dishwasher handle.
Dishwasher door is lowered open, exposing the racks.
Dishwasher remains open immediately before closing.
Hand has raised the dishwasher door to the closed position.
Hand pulls at the closed upper cabinet above the sink.
Cabinet doors are opening and shelves become visible.
Cabinet remains fully open just before closure.
Hand finishes pushing the cabinet doors closed.
Hand grips the closed drawer beside the refrigerator.
Drawer is pulled open, exposing stored wraps and bags.
Drawer remains open immediately before closure.
Drawer is fully closed.
Hand reaches for the upper refrigerator handle.
Upper refrigerator door is open and the interior light is visible.
Refrigerator door remains open immediately before closure.
Hand pushes the upper refrigerator door shut.
Upper refrigerator door is fully closed.
Hand reaches for the lower freezer handle.
Lower freezer door is open, revealing freezer drawers.
Hand begins pushing the open freezer door closed.
Lower freezer door is fully closed.
Laundry closet door is closed.
Door is open, revealing the stacked washer and dryer.
Hand pulls the laundry closet door toward its frame.
Laundry closet door is fully closed.

notes: Nine distinct open-and-close interaction episodes are visible. The refrigerator's upper fresh-food door and lower freezer door are treated as separate movable parts.
scene_description: A user moves through a studio apartment kitchen and living area, sequentially opening and closing a clothes closet, microwave, oven, dishwasher, cabinet, drawer, refrigerator compartments, and laundry closet.
